query: 童工/强迫劳动政策 童工/强迫劳动政策 衡量企业在人权底线方面的预防、识别与纠偏机制。 一、内容质量计算（50%） 基于政策是否包含以下四个核心模块（各占 1 分）： 模块 A：明确禁令。书面承诺禁止雇用 16 周岁以下童工（或当地法定年龄）及任何形式的强迫/债役劳动。 模块 B：识别与尽调。具备入职身份审核流程及定期的现场/远程人权尽调机制。 模块 C：申诉渠道。建立受保护的举报机制，允许员工及供应商员工反馈人权问题。 模块 D：纠偏与补救。明确若发现童工，如何确保其重返校园（如经济资助）；若发现强迫劳动，如何退还押金或证件。 • 2分（卓越）：完全覆盖四个核心模块（A：明确禁令；B：识别与尽调；C：有效申诉渠道；D：具体的纠偏与补救程序）。 • 1分（合格）：具备模块 A（禁令），并涵盖 B/C/D 中的任意 1-2 项，有基础的审核流程但缺乏深度的补救与纠偏机制。 • 0分（不合格）：仅有模块 A（口头承诺），或完全无相关政策披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：人权管理与尽调机制覆盖 >80% 的自有业务单元及核心供应商。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅覆盖自有员工而忽略了高风险的供应链环节，或未说明覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 童工 最低就业年龄 年龄核验 强迫劳动 强制劳动 债役劳动 现代奴役 扣押身份证件 扣押护照 招聘费 入职押金 限制人身自由 人权尽职调查 童工返校 退还押金 供应商劳工标准 child labour child labor minimum employment age age verification forced labour forced labor bonded labour modern slavery retention of identity documents passport retention recruitment fees employment deposits restriction of movement human rights due diligence child remediation supplier labour standards 是否书面禁止雇佣16周岁以下童工或低于当地法定最低就业年龄的人员，并禁止强迫劳动、债役劳动及现代奴役？ 是否实施年龄/身份核验及定期人权尽职调查？ 是否禁止扣押身份证件或护照、收取招聘费/押金、限制离职或行动自由？ 员工及供应商员工能否通过受保护渠道举报？ 发现童工或强迫劳动后有哪些补救措施？ 政策和尽调覆盖自有运营及哪些供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '童工/强迫劳动政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否书面禁止雇佣16周岁以下童工或低于当地法定最低就业年龄的人员，并禁止强迫劳动、债役劳动及现代奴役？ 是否实施年龄/身份核验及定期人权尽职调查？ 是否禁止扣押身份证件或护照、收取招聘费/押金、限制离职或行动自由？ 员工及供应商员工能否通过受保护渠道举报？ 发现童工或强迫劳动后有哪些补救措施？ 政策和尽调覆盖自有运营及哪些供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有一般人权口号；仅有反歧视政策；仅有供应商环境标准；仅有“遵守劳动法”而无具体禁令与机制；区分：本指标关注童工/强迫劳动的禁令、尽调、申诉与专项补救；违规纠正程序更泛，可覆盖多种违规；供应商行为准则需含明确劳工禁令才可映射；争议事件监控关注外部暴露事件而非政策机制。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

[Content]
We value our employees, and we encourage them to further their own personal development and make full use of their talents. We will not tolerate any forms of discrimination, harsh or inhumane treatment, including sexual harassment or abuse, corporal punishment, mental or physical abuse of any employee, or the threat of any such treatment. We do not make use of child labour or forced labour, both in our offices, and in the manufacturing and assembly of our products, and this is clearly stated in our General Business Principles. Our policies governing the matters discussed in this section are set out in our General Business Principles, and Human Resources (HR) policy manual.

results.text: Our operations in Singapore are governed by the Employment Act of 1968, and our operations in China (which include our China office and our main manufacturing partner in China) are governed by the Law of the People's Republic of China on Employment Contract. Under Article 15 of the Labour Law in China, it is illegal to hire employees under the age of 16. Under the Law of the Protection of Juveniles in Singapore, there are several work arrangement restrictions for employees aged 16 to 18 years old. As such, it is company policy not to hire employees under the age of 18.

[Content]
Our operations in Singapore are governed by the Employment Act of 1968, and our operations in China (which include our China office and our main manufacturing partner in China) are governed by the Law of the People's Republic of China on Employment Contract. Under Article 15 of the Labour Law in China, it is illegal to hire employees under the age of 16. Under the Law of the Protection of Juveniles in Singapore, there are several work arrangement restrictions for employees aged 16 to 18 years old. As such, it is company policy not to hire employees under the age of 18.

results.text: Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.

[Section]
Good Corporate Governance

[Content]
Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.

results.text: We are open, honest and ethical in all our dealings, and do not employ corrupt practices such as bribery or money laundering. Only gifts or hospitality that are reasonable and proportionate can be accepted or offered, and we do not make facilitation payments to speed up or secure the performance of a routine government action. Commission payments to business partners must also be justified by clear and demonstrable services they have rendered. With respect to money laundering, we track suspicious transactions such as payments between unknown entities through an excessive number of intermediaries, high-value cash transactions, or payments made or received by suspicious entities or involving high-risk countries. Any employee who suspects any such case has an obligation to report this to our compliance officers.
